title: Emergency infrastructure top-up
author: 0x63Aa10Ee45Df8C7719b1234567890AbCdEf9B24
body: Node infrastructure costs for the coming quarter were underestimated and the operations account is projected to run dry within two weeks. This proposal tops it up by 30,000 USDC. Given the timeline, the Steering Circle opened voting on an expedited schedule.
